Install omarchy-keyring on Omarchy

Omarchy Keyring holds the PGP keys pacman uses to verify that Omarchy packages actually came from the Omarchy project and haven't been tampered with. It's a tiny, invisible piece of plumbing installed alongside the package manager configuration rather than something you interact with directly. Without it, pacman would refuse to trust signed Omarchy packages.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-keyring
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 20251027-1:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-keyring

Open and use omarchy-keyring

omarchy-keyring has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql omarchy-keyring | grep /usr/bin/

omarchy-keyring requirements and compatibility

No special requirements are documented for omarchy-keyring.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-keyring on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-keyring. The download is 6.6 KB and it takes 676 B once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-keyring free?

Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later licensed). The package is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later.

How do I uninstall omarchy-keyring?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-keyring. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-keyring depend on?

omarchy-keyring declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is omarchy-keyring a desktop app?

No. omarchy-keyring has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is omarchy-keyring in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-keyring (version 20251027-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://omarchy.org.
